acceptance_criteria.description: Doctor warns on forged provider afterHash, remains ready on unchanged provider entries, and the focused doctor/provider tests pass.

closed_decisions: For each provider entry, providerStagingIntact requires the expected bundled hash, the manifest entry afterHash, and the actual staged content hash to be exactly equal.
Add a regression that initializes, forges one provider afterHash to a different valid 64-hex value while retaining canonical serialization, and expects integration.manifest warn without mutation.

focused: pnpm vitest run tests/integration/doctor.test.ts tests/unit/provider-source.test.ts tests/unit/attributed-drift.test.ts

forbidden_changes: Do not edit any other file or weaken provider bytes/path/attribution checks; no git, Jira, PR, or release mutations.
objective: Make doctor fail closed when a canonical provider manifest entry afterHash is forged even though staged bytes still match the bundled provider.
